contexts.name: reference
contexts.description: Lookup and master data shared by every other context: countries, currencies, ports, container types, commodity codes, vessel classes, trade lanes.

contexts.name: customer
contexts.description: Parties the carrier does business with: customers, groups, contacts, billing accounts, credit limits, contracts, portal logins and compliance checks.

contexts.name: booking
contexts.description: Commercial carriage requests: bookings, parties, container requests, routing legs, amendments, quotes, allocations, rollovers and waitlists.

contexts.name: equipment
contexts.description: Container and equipment assets and their lifecycle: containers, physical movements, tracking events, chassis, gensets, leases, inspections, damage and repair.

contexts.name: vessel
contexts.description: Ship master data and operations: vessels, owners, managers, engines, capacities, bays, crew, certificates, drydockings, AIS positions and fuel use.

contexts.name: voyage
contexts.description: Liner services and sailings: services, rotations, voyages, published sailing schedules, legs, delays, blank sailings, capacities and slot exchanges.

contexts.name: portcall
contexts.description: Vessel visits to ports: port calls, milestones, agents, pilotage, towage, mooring, port dues, bunkering, crew changes and crane assignments.

contexts.name: cargo
contexts.description: What is inside the containers: cargo lines, manifests, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge, VGM, packing lists, stowage plans, claims and insurance.

contexts.name: reefer
contexts.description: Refrigerated container operations: reefer machines, telemetry readings, set points, alarms, power connections, excursions and monitoring.

contexts.name: tariff
contexts.description: Pricing: published tariffs and rates, negotiated rate sheets, surcharges, bunker and currency factors, free time, demurrage tiers, contract rates and discounts.

contexts.name: invoicing
contexts.description: Billing and receivables: invoices, lines, credit notes, payments, allocations, tax, exchange rates, aging, dunning, disputes and revenue recognition.

contexts.name: customs
contexts.description: Border clearance: customs declarations and lines, duties, holds, inspections, brokers, bonds, advance filings, licences and trade agreements.

contexts.name: documentation
contexts.description: Shipping documents: bills of lading, sea waybills, shipping instructions, amendments, surrenders, delivery orders, stored documents and EDI traffic.

contexts.name: terminal
contexts.description: Container terminal operations: terminals, berths, cranes, yard blocks and slots, yard moves, gate transactions, truck appointments and rail loadings.

tables.name: Regions
tables.description: Geographic trade region such as Far East, North Europe or Mediterranean, used to group countries, ports and trade lanes.

columns.name: RegionId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the region row.

columns.name: RegionCode
columns.description: Short mnemonic of the region, for example FE or NEUR.

columns.name: RegionName
columns.description: Display name of the trade region.

columns.name: ParentRegionId
columns.description: Enclosing region when regions are nested, null for a top-level region.

tables.name: Languages
tables.description: Human language a customer, document template or contact can be addressed in.

columns.name: LanguageId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the language row.

columns.name: LanguageCode
columns.description: ISO 639-1 language code such as en, fr or zh.

tables.name: Currencies
tables.description: ISO 4217 currency in which freight, surcharges and invoices are denominated.

columns.name: CurrencyId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the currency row.

columns.name: CurrencyCode
columns.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR or CNY.

columns.name: MinorUnits
columns.description: Number of decimal places the currency uses.

tables.name: Countries
tables.description: Sovereign country used for addresses, vessel flags, customs jurisdictions and port locations.

columns.name: CountryId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the country row.

columns.name: CountryName
columns.description: English short name of the country.

columns.name: RegionId
columns.description: Trade region the country belongs to.

columns.name: CurrencyId
columns.description: Default currency used in the country.

columns.name: OfficialLanguageId
columns.description: Main official language of the country.

tables.name: TimeZones
tables.description: IANA time zone used to convert port and terminal local times to UTC.

columns.name: TimeZoneId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the time zone row.

columns.name: IanaName
columns.description: IANA zone identifier such as Europe/Rome.

columns.name: UtcOffsetMinutes
columns.description: Standard offset from UTC in minutes.

columns.name: ObservesDst
columns.description: Whether the zone observes daylight saving time.

tables.name: UnLocodes
tables.description: UN/LOCODE registry entry identifying any trade location (seaport, inland depot, airport), broader than the Ports table of operated seaports.

columns.name: UnLocodeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the un locode row.

columns.name: LocationCode
columns.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE, country code plus three-letter location.

columns.name: FunctionCodes
columns.description: UN/LOCODE function classifier digits, for example 1 for port and 4 for rail.

tables.name: Ports
tables.description: Seaport the liner network calls at, identified by UN/LOCODE; origin, destination and call location for bookings, sailing schedules and port calls.

columns.name: PortId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the port row.

columns.name: PortName
columns.description: Common name of the port, for example Rotterdam.

columns.name: UnLocode
columns.description: UN/LOCODE of the port such as NLRTM.

columns.name: CountryId
columns.description: Country the port is located in.

columns.name: TimeZoneId
columns.description: Local time zone of the port.

columns.name: IsHubPort
columns.description: True when the port is a transhipment hub in the network.

tables.name: ContainerSizes
tables.description: Nominal container length class (20, 40, 45 foot) with its TEU equivalence.

columns.name: ContainerSizeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container size row.

columns.name: TeuFactor
columns.description: Twenty-foot-equivalent units one container of this size counts for.

tables.name: ContainerTypes
tables.description: ISO 6346 container type such as 20 foot dry, 40 foot high cube or 40 foot reefer, with tare weight and payload limits.

columns.name: ContainerTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container type row.

columns.name: TypeCode
columns.description: ISO 6346 size-type code such as 22G1 or 45R1.

columns.name: TypeName
columns.description: Descriptive name, for example 40 foot high cube.

columns.name: TareWeightKg
columns.description: Empty weight of the container in kilograms.

tables.name: UnitsOfMeasure
tables.description: Unit of measure for quantities, weights and volumes on cargo and customs lines.

columns.name: UnitsOfMeasureId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the units of measure row.

columns.name: UomCode
columns.description: Short unit code such as KGM, CBM or PCE.

columns.name: UomName
columns.description: Name of the unit, for example kilogram.

tables.name: CommodityCodes
tables.description: Harmonized System commodity classification used to describe cargo, assess duties and pick reefer settings.

columns.name: CommodityCodeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the commodity code row.

columns.name: ParentCommodityId
columns.description: Parent chapter or heading in the HS hierarchy.

columns.name: DefaultUomId
columns.description: Customary unit for quantifying the commodity.

columns.name: IsPerishable
columns.description: True when the commodity needs temperature control.

columns.name: IsDangerousByDefault
columns.description: True when shipping it normally needs a dangerous goods declaration.

tables.name: VesselClasses
tables.description: Size class of container ship such as Feeder, Panamax or Ultra Large Container Vessel, by TEU capacity range.

columns.name: VesselClassId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel class row.

columns.name: MinTeuCapacity
columns.description: Lower bound of nominal TEU capacity for the class.

columns.name: MaxTeuCapacity
columns.description: Upper bound of nominal TEU capacity for the class.

columns.name: TypicalLengthMeters
columns.description: Typical overall length of ships in the class.

tables.name: Incoterms
tables.description: Incoterms trade term defining who arranges and pays for carriage, insurance and clearance between seller and buyer.

columns.name: IncotermId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the incoterm row.

columns.name: IncotermCode
columns.description: Three-letter Incoterms code such as FOB or CIF.

columns.name: IncotermName
columns.description: Full name of the trade term.

columns.name: SellerPaysMainCarriage
columns.description: True when the seller pays the ocean freight.

tables.name: PackageTypes
tables.description: Kind of outer packaging (pallet, carton, drum, bag) cargo is declared in.

columns.name: PackageTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the package type row.

columns.name: DefaultUomId
columns.description: Unit normally used to count this package type.

tables.name: HazardClasses
tables.description: IMDG dangerous goods hazard class or division, for example Class 3 flammable liquids.

columns.name: HazardClassId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the hazard class row.

columns.name: ClassNumber
columns.description: IMDG class or division number such as 3 or 6.1.

columns.name: RequiresPlacard
columns.description: True when containers need an external hazard placard.

tables.name: TradeLanes
tables.description: Directional trade lane between two regions, for example Far East to North Europe, used to organise services, surcharges and contracts.

columns.name: TradeLaneId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the trade lane row.

columns.name: IsHeadhaul
columns.description: True for the dominant cargo direction of the lane.

tables.name: PaymentTerms
tables.description: Standard payment terms offered to customers, such as net 30 days.

columns.name: PaymentTermId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the payment term row.

columns.name: TermsCode
columns.description: Short code of the payment terms.

columns.name: DaysNet
columns.description: Days after invoice date that payment falls due.

tables.name: DocumentTypes
tables.description: Kind of shipping document such as bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin or dangerous goods declaration.

columns.name: DocumentTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the document type row.

columns.name: DocTypeCode
columns.description: Short code of the document type.

columns.name: IsCustomerFacing
columns.description: True when customers can see and download documents of this type.

tables.name: CustomerTypes
tables.description: Role a customer plays in the supply chain: shipper, consignee, freight forwarder, NVOCC or beneficial cargo owner.

columns.name: CustomerTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer type row.

tables.name: CustomerSegments
tables.description: Commercial segment used to tier customers, such as global key account or mid-market, by annual volume.

columns.name: CustomerSegmentId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer segment row.

columns.name: MinAnnualTeu
columns.description: Minimum annual TEU volume for a customer to qualify.

tables.name: SalesOffices
tables.description: MSC-style local sales and customer service office that owns customer relationships in a country.

columns.name: SalesOfficeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the sales office row.

tables.name: SalesRepresentatives
tables.description: Employee who manages customer accounts, approves credit and signs contracts.

columns.name: SalesRepresentativeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the sales representative row.

tables.name: CustomerGroups
tables.description: Corporate group that several customer legal entities belong to, for global account management and credit roll-up.

columns.name: CustomerGroupId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer group row.

columns.name: ParentCustomerGroupId
columns.description: Parent group in a group hierarchy.

columns.name: GlobalAccountManagerId
columns.description: Representative responsible for the whole group.

tables.name: Customers
tables.description: Legal entity that books, ships, receives or pays for cargo: shippers, consignees, forwarders and beneficial cargo owners.

columns.name: CustomerId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer row.

columns.name: CustomerCode
columns.description: Short unique customer code used on documents.

columns.name: CustomerTypeId
columns.description: Supply chain role of the customer.

columns.name: CustomerGroupId
columns.description: Corporate group the customer belongs to.

columns.name: IsActive
columns.description: False once the customer is closed or blocked.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.description: When the customer record was created.

tables.name: CustomerAddresses
tables.description: Postal address of a customer used for billing, delivery or registered office.

columns.name: CustomerAddressId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer address row.

tables.name: CustomerContacts
tables.description: Named person at a customer who receives booking confirmations, invoices and notifications.

columns.name: CustomerContactId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer contact row.

columns.name: ContactRole
columns.description: Function such as Logistics, Finance or Customs.

columns.name: PreferredLanguageId
columns.description: Language to use when writing to the contact.

tables.name: CustomerAccounts
tables.description: Billing account of a customer in a currency and payment terms; invoices and payments are posted against it.

columns.name: CustomerAccountId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer account row.

columns.name: PaymentTermsId
columns.description: Payment terms agreed for the account.

columns.name: IsOnCreditHold
columns.description: True when new bookings are blocked for non-payment.

tables.name: CustomerCreditLimits
tables.description: Approved credit limit of a billing account for a validity period; compared with open receivables before releasing bookings.

columns.name: CustomerCreditLimitId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer credit limit row.

columns.name: EffectiveTo
columns.description: Last day the limit applies, null when open-ended.

tables.name: ContractTypes
tables.description: Kind of commercial agreement: named account contract, annual BCO contract, spot or project.

columns.name: ContractTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the contract type row.

tables.name: CustomerContracts
tables.description: Negotiated service contract between the carrier and a customer fixing rates and volume commitments on a trade lane for a period.

columns.name: CustomerContractId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer contract row.

columns.name: TradeLaneId
columns.description: Lane the contract covers, null when global.

columns.name: MinimumVolumeTeu
columns.description: Committed TEU volume over the term.

columns.name: SignedBySalesRepId
columns.description: Representative who signed for the carrier.

tables.name: CustomerPortalUsers
tables.description: Login of a customer contact on the online booking and tracking portal.

columns.name: CustomerPortalUserId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer portal user row.

columns.name: IsLocked
columns.description: True when the login is locked.

tables.name: NotificationPreferences
tables.description: Which shipment events a customer contact wants to be notified about and over which channel.

columns.name: NotificationPreferenceId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the notification preference row.

columns.name: EventCode
columns.description: Shipment event notified, for example VESSEL_DEPARTED.

columns.name: IsEnabled
columns.description: Whether the notification is switched on.

tables.name: CustomerKycChecks
tables.description: Know-your-customer onboarding or periodic review performed on a customer.

columns.name: CustomerKycCheckId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the customer kyc check row.

tables.name: SanctionsScreenings
tables.description: Result of screening a customer name against sanctions and denied-party lists.

columns.name: SanctionsScreeningId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the sanctions screening row.

columns.name: ListName
columns.description: Sanctions list checked, for example OFAC SDN.

tables.name: BookingStatuses
tables.description: Lifecycle state of a booking such as requested, confirmed, shipped or cancelled.

columns.name: BookingStatusId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking status row.

columns.name: IsTerminal
columns.description: True when no further transitions are possible.

tables.name: BookingTypes
tables.description: Commercial kind of booking: standard, spot, contract or transhipment.

columns.name: BookingTypeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking type row.

tables.name: Bookings
tables.description: One confirmed carriage request from a customer, the commercial root of a shipment from which containers, documents and invoices hang.

columns.name: BookingId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking row.

columns.name: CustomerId
columns.description: The contracting party that booked the cargo.

columns.name: CustomerContractId
columns.description: Service contract the booking is under, null for spot.

columns.name: IncotermId
columns.description: Trade term between shipper and consignee.

columns.name: SailingScheduleId
columns.description: Published sailing the booking is allocated to.

columns.name: RateSheetId
columns.description: Negotiated rate offer applied to the booking.

columns.name: CargoReadyDate
columns.description: Date the cargo is ready for pick-up.

tables.name: BookingParties
tables.description: Additional party on a booking such as shipper, consignee or notify party.

columns.name: BookingPartyId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking party row.

tables.name: BookingContainerRequests
tables.description: Requested quantity of a container type on a booking, optionally with the commodity and weight per unit.

columns.name: BookingContainerRequestId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking container request row.

columns.name: GrossWeightKgPerUnit
columns.description: Expected gross weight per container in kilograms.

tables.name: BookingLegs
tables.description: One transport leg of a booked routing; multi-leg bookings are transhipments across voyages.

columns.name: BookingLegId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking leg row.

columns.name: LegSequence
columns.description: Order of the leg in the routing, starting at 1.

tables.name: BookingAmendments
tables.description: Audit trail of a field changed on a booking after confirmation.

columns.name: BookingAmendmentId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking amendment row.

tables.name: BookingCancellations
tables.description: Cancellation of a booking with reason and any cancellation fee charged.

columns.name: BookingCancellationId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking cancellation row.

tables.name: BookingReferences
tables.description: Customer-supplied reference attached to a booking, such as purchase order or shipper reference.

columns.name: BookingReferenceId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking reference row.

columns.name: ReferenceType
columns.description: Kind of reference, for example PO or SHIPPER_REF.

tables.name: BookingNotes
tables.description: Free-text internal note written by staff on a booking.

columns.name: BookingNoteId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking note row.

tables.name: BookingAllocations
tables.description: Vessel space (container slots) reserved for a booking on a voyage by container type.

columns.name: BookingAllocationId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking allocation row.

columns.name: BookingId
columns.description: Booking the space is reserved for.

columns.name: ContainerTypeId
columns.description: Container type of the reserved slots.

tables.name: BookingQuotes
tables.description: Priced offer given to a customer before a booking exists; may convert into a booking when accepted.

columns.name: BookingQuoteId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking quote row.

columns.name: CustomerId
columns.description: Customer the quote was issued to.

columns.name: RateSheetId
columns.description: Rate offer the prices came from.

columns.name: ValidUntil
columns.description: Last day the quote can be accepted.

columns.name: ConvertedBookingId
columns.description: Booking created from the quote, null if not accepted.

tables.name: QuoteLines
tables.description: One priced component (freight or a surcharge) of a quote.

columns.name: QuoteLineId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the quote line row.

columns.name: SurchargeTypeId
columns.description: Surcharge being quoted, null for base freight.

tables.name: BookingTemplates
tables.description: Saved booking pattern a customer reuses for repeat shipments on the same lane.

columns.name: BookingTemplateId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking template row.

tables.name: BookingRollovers
tables.description: Event where a booking is moved off one voyage onto a later one because of lack of space or a schedule change.

columns.name: BookingRolloverId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking rollover row.

columns.name: FromVoyageId
columns.description: Voyage the booking was originally on.

columns.name: ToVoyageId
columns.description: Voyage the booking was moved to.

tables.name: BookingWaitlistEntries
tables.description: Booking waiting for space to free up on a fully booked voyage.

columns.name: BookingWaitlistEntryId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the booking waitlist entry row.

columns.name: VoyageId
columns.description: Voyage the booking is waiting for.

columns.name: QueuePosition
columns.description: Place in the queue, 1 is next.

columns.name: AddedAtUtc
columns.description: When the booking joined the waitlist.

tables.name: ContainerStatuses
tables.description: Operational status of a container such as in service, in repair, on lease return or lost.

columns.name: ContainerStatusId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container status row.

columns.name: IsAvailableForBooking
columns.description: True when containers in this status can be assigned to bookings.

tables.name: Lessors
tables.description: Leasing company that supplies containers to the carrier.

columns.name: LessorId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the lessor row.

tables.name: Depots
tables.description: Off-terminal container depot where empty containers are stored, inspected and repaired.

columns.name: DepotId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the depot row.

tables.name: Containers
tables.description: Physical shipping container identified by its ISO 6346 number (four letters, six digits, check digit); the asset that is tracked, loaded and invoiced.

columns.name: ContainerId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container row.

columns.name: ContainerNumber
columns.description: ISO 6346 container number such as MSCU1234567.

columns.name: ContainerTypeId
columns.description: Size and type of the container.

columns.name: LessorId
columns.description: Leasing company when the box is leased, null when owned.

columns.name: OwnerCustomerId
columns.description: Shipper owning the box for shipper-owned containers.

columns.name: HomeDepotId
columns.description: Depot the container is normally returned to.

columns.name: ManufactureYear
columns.description: Year of manufacture from the CSC plate.

columns.name: CscPlateExpiry
columns.description: Next CSC safety inspection due date.

tables.name: ContainerMovements
tables.description: Physical handling transactions of a container recorded by terminal and depot systems: gate in, gate out, load, discharge, empty return. Answers where a container is and how long it dwelled.

columns.name: ContainerMovementId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container movement row.

columns.name: MovementCode
columns.description: GATE_IN, GATE_OUT, LOAD, DISCHARGE or EMPTY_RETURN.

columns.name: BookingId
columns.description: Booking the container was moving under.

columns.name: VoyageId
columns.description: Voyage for load and discharge moves.

columns.name: OccurredAtUtc
columns.description: When the physical movement took place.

columns.name: IsLaden
columns.description: True when the container was loaded with cargo.

tables.name: ContainerEvents
tables.description: Customer-facing tracking milestones for a container published via EDI or API, such as empty released or estimated arrival; derived reports, not the physical handling log.

columns.name: ContainerEventId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container event row.

columns.name: EventCode
columns.description: Milestone code such as EMPTY_RELEASED or ETA_UPDATED.

tables.name: EquipmentPools
tables.description: Pool of interchangeable equipment such as chassis and gensets managed at a port.

columns.name: EquipmentPoolId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the equipment pool row.

columns.name: PortId
columns.description: Port the pool is managed at.

columns.name: TargetUnits
columns.description: Number of units the pool should hold.

tables.name: Chassis
tables.description: Wheeled chassis used to carry a container by road.

columns.name: ChassisId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the chassis row.

columns.name: ChassisType
columns.description: Size or axle configuration, for example 40 foot tri-axle.

columns.name: HomeDepotId
columns.description: Depot where the chassis is normally stored.

tables.name: Gensets
tables.description: Clip-on diesel generator set powering a reefer container while on a chassis or train.

columns.name: GensetId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the genset row.

columns.name: HomeDepotId
columns.description: Depot where the genset is stored.

tables.name: EquipmentMovements
tables.description: Movements of non-container equipment (chassis and gensets) between depots; separate from container handling in ContainerMovements.

columns.name: EquipmentMovementId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the equipment movement row.

tables.name: ContainerLeases
tables.description: Lease of a container from a lessor with rate and term.

columns.name: ContainerLeaseId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container lease row.

columns.name: LeaseEnd
columns.description: Last day, null while the lease is open.

tables.name: ContainerInspections
tables.description: Survey of a container's condition at a depot or terminal.

columns.name: ContainerInspectionId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container inspection row.

columns.name: DepotId
columns.description: Depot where the survey took place.

tables.name: ContainerDamages
tables.description: Damage found on a container, with IICL damage code and severity.

columns.name: ContainerDamageId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container damage row.

tables.name: RepairEstimates
tables.description: Cost estimate to repair a container damage, approved or rejected by the owner.

columns.name: RepairEstimateId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the repair estimate row.

columns.name: ApprovedAtUtc
columns.description: When the estimate was approved, null while pending.

tables.name: ContainerSeals
tables.description: High-security seal applied to a container door, with application and breakage records.

columns.name: ContainerSealId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the container seal row.

columns.name: ContainerId
columns.description: Container the seal was fitted to.

columns.name: AppliedAtTerminalId
columns.description: Terminal where the seal was fitted.

columns.name: BrokenAtUtc
columns.description: When the seal was broken, null while intact.

tables.name: EquipmentInterchanges
tables.description: Equipment Interchange Receipt (EIR) recording a container's condition when handed between carrier, trucker and depot.

columns.name: EquipmentInterchangeId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the equipment interchange row.

columns.name: TruckingCompanyId
columns.description: Trucker taking or returning the container.

tables.name: VesselOwners
tables.description: Registered owner company of one or more ships.

columns.name: VesselOwnerId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel owner row.

tables.name: VesselManagers
tables.description: Ship management company responsible for crewing and technical operation.

columns.name: VesselManagerId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel manager row.

tables.name: Vessels
tables.description: Container ship in the fleet, identified by IMO number, with its size, capacity and ownership particulars.

columns.name: VesselId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel row.

columns.name: ImoNumber
columns.description: Seven-digit IMO number, permanent ship identifier.

columns.name: FlagCountryId
columns.description: Flag state the ship is registered under.

columns.name: IsActive
columns.description: False once the ship has left the fleet.

tables.name: FlagRegistrations
tables.description: History of the flag state a vessel was registered under, with call sign and period.

columns.name: FlagRegistrationId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the flag registration row.

columns.name: RegisteredTo
columns.description: End of the registration, null when current.

tables.name: VesselCharters
tables.description: Charter agreement under which a vessel is hired in from or out to another company.

columns.name: VesselCharterId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel charter row.

tables.name: VesselCertificates
tables.description: Statutory certificate a ship must hold, such as safety construction or ISM, with expiry.

columns.name: VesselCertificateId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel certificate row.

columns.name: VesselId
columns.description: Vessel the certificate was issued to.

tables.name: VesselEngines
tables.description: Main engine installed on a vessel.

columns.name: VesselEngineId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel engine row.

columns.name: FuelType
columns.description: Fuel the engine burns, for example VLSFO or LNG.

tables.name: VesselBays
tables.description: Stowage bay of a ship's cargo hold or deck, the geometry containers are positioned in.

columns.name: VesselBayId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel bay row.

columns.name: BayNumber
columns.description: Bay number counted from the bow.

columns.name: MaxTiers
columns.description: Maximum container tiers stackable in the bay.

columns.name: IsOnDeck
columns.description: True for deck bays, false for in-hold bays.

tables.name: VesselCapacities
tables.description: Slot capacity of a vessel for a given container type, including reefer plugs.

columns.name: VesselCapacityId
columns.description: Surrogate key of the vessel capacity row.

columns.name: SlotCount
columns.description: Number of slots for the type.
